postings.title: Equity Options Trader
postings.description:
Our Europe & Brazil Equity Options market has traditionally focused on highly liquid stocks but has expanded in scope to many more symbols. As a result, we have a wide range of new and exciting problems to solve. We are looking for experienced Equity Options Trader to strengthen the group, help us tackle these new challenges and expand our fast-growing team to cover more symbols and regions, with a particular focus on positional trading strategies.

Your core responsibilities:

- You will maximize revenue by creating competitive edge trading strategies, using our existing signals suite and contributing to its improvement

- You will have lots of responsibility and ownership early on to drive strategies forward and be successful

- IMC is highly collaborative between traders, quants, and developers so the scope of responsibility is fairly fluid involving a mixture of operational trading and data-driven analysis

- We’ve already created partnerships and business models to facilitate our expansion and we’re currently working to improve our options pricing; investigating new models and improving our existing framework

Your skills and experience:

- You are an experienced equity option trader with at least 2 years’ experience

- You have relevant tertiary qualifications (graduate or post graduate), with strong academic results, preference in mathematics, science, financial engineering or computer science

- You have proven ability to act and perform successfully in a fast moving and high pressured environment

- You have a passion for learning; you are driven to succeed, you work well individually and in a team to get results

- Experience in computer programming is a plus (Python, C/C++, Java, Matlab, SQL)

- You will be highly analytical, constantly enhancing your strategies to improve the quality of trades, pinpoint missed opportunities, and identify new trading ideas and products

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

postings.title: Trading Recruiter
postings.description:
We are seeking a Trading Recruiter to join our team and help scale IMC’s talent acquisition efforts across Europe. In this role, you will be instrumental in attracting and securing exceptional talent in trading and quantitative research—disciplines that are critical to our continued success. As a strategic partner to the business, you will collaborate closely with leadership and global recruitment teams to craft and execute scalable, forward-thinking hiring strategies that align with our long-term vision—ensuring we consistently attract and secure top talent in the industry.

Your Core Responsibilities:

- Own end-to-end recruitment for trading and quantitative research openings in Europe

- Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, offering insights on market trends, talent availability, and best practices to inform hiring decisions

- Leverage a deep understanding of IMC’s culture, goals, and industry to develop creative and effective sourcing strategies that reach passive and active candidates in competitive markets

- Maintain and grow a strong industry network to proactively identify and attract top-tier candidates from niche fields

- Evaluate candidates for both technical expertise and cultural alignment to ensure their skills, experience, and values meet the needs of the hiring team

- Create a personalized and engaging experience that highlights IMC’s unique strengths

- Continuously assess and refine recruitment processes to maximize efficiency, effectiveness, and the quality of hire

- Provide regular updates to stakeholders, celebrating successes, addressing challenges, and offering data-driven insights to inform recruitment strategies

Your Skills and Experience:

- 3+ years recruitment experience with a proven track record of securing top-tier trading and quantitative research talent across Europe

- A track record of success in securing top talent, including candidates with multiple offers

- Ability to engage candidates, collaborate effectively with hiring managers, and influence decisions

- Skilled at using metrics to evaluate performance and guide recruitment strategies

- Flexible and able to pivot priorities as needs evolve

- Comfortable using applicant tracking systems (ATS) and recruitment tools

- Highly motivated self-starter with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
